 Mercedes-Benz recalls its most expensive cars in Australia
 Both the Mercedes-Maybach and the Mercedes-Benz versions of the S-Class have been recalled due to a brake fluid leak.
 by 
 Jordan Mulach 
 Published 
 November 08, 2026
 Link copied! 
 Copy failed! 
 Mercedes-Maybach S680 L 
 Mercedes-Benz Australia has recalled 192 examples of the S-Class, including in Maybach guise, after it was discovered the front brake hoses could leak fluid.
 “Due to a manufacturing defect, the front axle brake hoses may become damaged over time. If this occurs it could lead to a brake fluid leak resulting in reduced braking performance," the carmaker said in its recall notice .
 “A reduction in braking performance could increase the risk of an accident causing injury or death to vehicle occupants and other road users.”
 Mercedes-Benz S580 The recall impacts examples of the S-Class built between 2022 and 2024, with a full list of affected Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) available here .
 When new, the Mercedes-Maybach S680 was priced from $576,600 before on-road costs, making it the dearest car the brand sold in Australia at the time.
 Mercedes-Benz has told owners to contact their preferred dealer to have the work carried out, free of charge.
 For more information, owners can call Mercedes-Benz Australia’s customer assistance centre on 1300 762 718, or by emailing [email protected] .
